title: HITL review record
description: Human review and approval trail for one article (AES-P5.1 / SUE-457). Designed to be produced in an ordinary chat conversation: every field is something a person can state in a sentence. There is no field an AI can set to grant approval — approval carries a human name and a decision, and the validator checks the pairing.

reviewer.description: A human name. An AI may prepare a review summary; it may not be the reviewer.

against_version.description: The article version the human actually read. Approval never applies to a version nobody saw.

feedback.description: One item of feedback, routed to the artifact it actually changes.

changes.description: Which upstream artifact this feedback edits. Routing is the point: a thesis complaint changes the frame, not the prose.

material.description: True when the change touches a fact, number, date, citation, quotation, or the claim set. Material changes force re-verification.

finalization.description: The finalization receipt. This is the editorial `Final`, which materializes as suengj-com `status: draft`. It is not publication.

target_status.description: Always `draft`. Finalization is not publication, and this field exists to make the attempt visible rather than possible.
